## Why visit

A highly distinctive dockside building, with its narrow flat-iron shape and nautical character, gives this stop a strong sense of place. The current operator’s beer policy is unusually useful: local independent brewers, a regular Brimstage bitter and rotating pale, golden and dark options. That makes it a good introduction to Merseyside brewing before visiting a production taproom. Use it to connect waterfront sightseeing with Black Lodge and the Baltic area, or enjoy it on its own as a traditional pub beside the docks.

## Beer

Official site advertises four cask lines, including regular Brimstage Trapper’s Hat and rotating local beers. Current operation is a pub; do not assume on-site brewing.
